goal: Junior Python backend developer, starting from zero
notes: Module order implies prerequisites. A concept may only rely on concepts from earlier modules or earlier in its own module.
est_lessons counts regular lessons only; the planner adds review lessons (~1 in 5) and the module project on top.
Concept ids are stable keys used by lesson.json and mastery tracking; never rename, only deprecate.
